name: The Distinctive
summary: Build-your-own Calling that borrows a racial passive and two racial skills from other races.

innate.name: I Can Do That, Too
innate.summary: Gain one passive racial ability from the rulebook that the character does not already have.

skills.name: Distinctive <Skill Name> (first)
skills.requirement: Mirrors the racial skill chosen in choice racial-skill-a; still a Calling skill for advancing, techniques, granting, and restoring.

basic.summary: As the chosen racial skill's Basic level, with any flavor.

expert.summary: As the chosen racial skill's Expert level.

master.summary: As the chosen racial skill's Master level.

grandmaster.summary: As the chosen racial skill's Grandmaster level.

skills.name: Distinctive <Skill Name> (second)
skills.requirement: Mirrors the racial skill chosen in choice racial-skill-b; still a Calling skill for advancing, techniques, granting, and restoring.

basic.summary: As the chosen racial skill's Basic level, with any flavor.

expert.summary: As the chosen racial skill's Expert level.

master.summary: As the chosen racial skill's Master level.

grandmaster.summary: As the chosen racial skill's Grandmaster level.

name: The Dream Warden
summary: Defender of the Plane of Dream who fights the Nightmare and inspires allies.

innate.name: Champion Of Dreams
innate.summary: Living relic of Dream: throw Dream damage packets without a phys rep and deal Dream with any wielded weapon. Always has Planar Asylum: Dream. Grant self a resist fear on a 100 count, max 1 held.

basic.summary: Packet or weapon "awaken" (Slay against nightmare creatures), or place a Dream Rune (E): deal Dream with any weapon or relic, spend it to resist a call containing Fear or Nightmare.

expert.summary: Group Dream Rune, or Group Dream Empowerment: 5 relic, weapon, or claw attacks at +10 Dream.

master.summary: Packet Magic Sleep or packet Banish Nightmare.

grandmaster.summary: Dream Storm: feet planted, repeated "storm" packets for 25 Dream until you move, take any effect, or use another skill. Or Dance of Dreams: swing 25 Dream with no other offensive skills, until ended or end of encounter.

basic.summary: 100 count: restore 1 basic skill use to someone else (once per encounter per person, once per repop per skill). Passive: 100 count "Lash grant planar asylum - dream".

expert.summary: Dream Ward on self (E), reduced effect from Nightmare damage; or a phys-repped Dream Circle up to 10' across blocking nightmare creatures and their melee, fear immunity and reduced thrown nightmare damage inside, until you act offensively, leave, or the encounter ends.

master.summary: For the encounter, Intercept any effect with Fear or Nightmare in the call. Passive: hold a 2nd self-granted resist fear.

grandmaster.summary: After a 30 count, "Voice Radius - Refit Armor", once per encounter. Passive: hold a 3rd self-granted resist fear.

name: The Elemental Mage
summary: Mage devoted to one element who gives up its opposing element.

innate.name: Elemental Alignment
innate.summary: Pick one of the six base elements. Living relic of it (packets for its damage, no phys rep) and planar asylum to its realm.

detriment.summary: Cannot learn the opposing element's magic, cast or use items that use or create its effects, and its beneficial or enhancement spells have no effect on you.

skills.name: Elemental Magic
skills.requirement: Element of focus (assumed same as the aligned element).

basic.summary: Cast a basic spell of the chosen element.

expert.summary: Cast an expert spell of the chosen element.

master.summary: Cast a master spell of the chosen element.

grandmaster.summary: Cast a grandmaster spell of the chosen element.

basic.summary: Spell Cleave one packet spell of your element: 2 packets on different targets.

expert.summary: Next offensive or healing spell of your element becomes a Frontal Cone, or every spell you cast this encounter becomes your element.

master.summary: Next offensive or healing spell of your element becomes a Lash, or next enhancement-occupying spell of it becomes a Group Cast (4 targets). Passive: immune to your own spells of your element.

grandmaster.summary: Next offensive or healing spell of your element becomes a Voice Radius, or next enhancement-occupying spell of it becomes a Lash.

name: The Fortune Favored
summary: Charmed risk-taker whose luck is tied to a lucky coin.

innate.name: Under Lucky Stars
innate.summary: No upkeep. 100 count in a Safe Space: gain Fortune's Favor (max 1, no enhancement slot), call "Lucky Evade" against the next 3 detrimental non-AoE effects with a number in the call. Must always carry Lucky Items: a non-kingdom coin first, plus 1 more item per technique learned in this Calling.

detriment.summary: Without the Lucky Coin, this Calling's abilities are unavailable until it is recovered or a new coin is imbued over 1 month.

basic.summary: Ask a Basic Augury and flip the coin. Tails: normal yes/no. Heads: answered as an Expert Augury.

expert.summary: "Resist Charm" or "Resist Trap" when hit by a charm or trap.

master.summary: "Fortunate One - Cure Ailments": purge all standard rulebook negative effects on self; if any were removed, also gain a new Fortune's Favor.

grandmaster.summary: 10 count: give a target a Lucky Dodge (as Master Evasion Dodge, called "Lucky Dodge"), occupies an enhancement slot until used, 1 per person. Passive: the innate may give self a Lucky Dodge instead of Fortune's Favor, one or the other at a time.

basic.summary: Flip the coin. Tails: gain 1 use of Evasion. Heads: gain 1 use of Finesse.

expert.summary: One packet or Weapon Strike Destruction.

master.summary: When hit by a non-AoE effect, redirect it to another target (not the source): ranged by packet, melee by "Point - <Effect>" within weapon reach.

grandmaster.summary: When affected by an enemy, "Reflect - Stun X" at them; X is the effect's number, or 100 if none.

name: The Librarian
summary: Library scholar unmatched at research and at sharing knowledge.

innate.name: Research Specialization
innate.summary: One GM-approved narrow research specialization; research on it costs 1 fewer Research use (minimum 1). Broad topics are not allowed.

basic.summary: 100 count, touch: "Spark of Insight - Disenchant Knowledge, restore one skill use". Removes a knowledge enhancement and restores 1 skill use.

expert.summary: 100 count: Amplify Knowledge buff in a regular enhancement slot. Knowledge skill hits 1 extra target, and each target may pick a different skill when choosing one already known.

master.summary: 100 count: "Restore Knowledge" on one target, refilling uses from its knowledge buffs (each buff counts as a separate renewal).

grandmaster.summary: Next Knowledge use may target Calling skills the target already has (never Librarian skills to non-Librarians); that buff counts as a Calling skill for restores. Max 1 per person.

basic.summary: Spend uses equal to your highest named level in this skill to make a teaching paper; someone spends a skill's uses to teach it to the paper, a later reader learns it and the paper crumbles. Tiers: Basic/Expert non-advanced Basic/Expert; Master non-advanced Master or advanced Basic; Grandmaster non-advanced Grandmaster or advanced Expert.

expert.summary: Spend 2 uses with Research (notes) or Amplify Research (papers) for results 1 step higher. Not for Ritual Scripts.

master.summary: Esoteric reasoning on a research question: get answers not written directly anywhere.

grandmaster.summary: Consult a library colleague with a chosen specialization on one question, for extra information or to break research blocks.

name: The Protector
summary: Bodyguard who shields a chosen Ward.

innate.name: Wardship
innate.summary: 100 count: make a willing target in sight your Ward. Max 1. Ends if the Ward is more than 10 feet away or the encounter ends. Cannot name a Ward while being a Ward.

basic.summary: Self and Ward gain +25 Temporary Armor Points or +25 life points. Passive: 100 count to grant self an intercept usable only for the Ward, 1 held.

expert.summary: Parry a physical effect harming the Ward. Passive: the 100 count intercept is hastened.

master.summary: Parry any effect targeting the Ward (spell, gas, voice, lash, cone, etc.); for AoE only the Ward is spared. Passive: 2nd intercept slot, and these intercepts work for anyone.

grandmaster.summary: Move all negative effects and damage, death included, from the Ward to yourself; cannot be mitigated. Passive: a 2nd Ward, or with 1 Ward all damage it takes is reduced.

basic.summary: 10 count: self AND Ward gain +10 Life Points and +10 Armor Points (healable, refittable, no enhancement slot, ignore Disenchant) for the encounter or until no Ward; stacks up to 1 + techniques in Protection. Passive: your armor refits are hastened.

expert.summary: Resist one status or damaging effect. Passive: ignore any Charm that would make you harm, abandon, or neglect your Ward.

master.summary: Instantly refit your and your Ward's armor. Passive: base refit for you or your Ward drops from 100 to 80.

grandmaster.summary: For the encounter or until no Ward, defensive skills for you or your Ward cost 1 use less. Passive: base refit drops from 100 to 60.

name: The Quartermaster
summary: Resourceful item user who sets augments freely and stretches consumables.

innate.name: Set Augment
innate.summary: Set any consumable augment for free (no skill uses) on a 100 count; item type limits still apply.

basic.summary: With Set Augment, create an unstable augment slot for it; once per item per technique known in Supplies.

expert.summary: Get a second use from a consumable, used in the same encounter.

master.summary: Pull any basic or expert crafted consumable from your pouches; always unstable.

grandmaster.summary: Pull any master crafted consumable from your pouches; always unstable.

skills.name: Craft Consumable
skills.requirement: Must be able to craft the item through another skill.

basic.summary: Craft any basic unstable consumable you can craft through another skill.

expert.summary: Craft any expert unstable consumable you can craft through another skill.

master.summary: Craft any master unstable consumable you can craft through another skill.

grandmaster.summary: Craft any grandmaster unstable consumable you can craft through another skill.

name: The Reliquist
summary: Relic specialist bonded to an unshatterable Spirit-Forged Relic.

innate.name: Focused Charge
innate.summary: Each 1 count adds +1 damage to the next relic attack, up to the 20 cap. May imbue one relic with a spirit fragment to make a Spirit-Forged Relic, unshatterable while held; the fragment is lost only if the relic is destroyed.

choices.label: Permanent extra damage types on the Spirit-Forged Relic

basic.summary: Add one extra elemental damage type to the Spirit-Forged Relic for 1 encounter.

expert.summary: Deliver relic damage with the call "Frontal Cone - 100 <Relic Type>". Passive: the relic permanently gains a 2nd elemental damage type.

master.summary: Twice per encounter, "Lash - 100 <Relic Type>". Passive: permanently add 2 more elemental types (+3 total). Passive: Basic use may instead make one attack x2 Vorpal (20 Physical Fire becomes 40 Vorpal Fire).

grandmaster.summary: Three times per encounter, "Point - 100 <Relic Type>". Passive: permanently add 2 more elemental types, or one of Radiance, Nature, Dream, Spirit, Magic. Passive: Focused Charge caps at 30 instead of 20 (passive damage still caps at 20).

basic.summary: 10 count: give another relic +1 passive relic damage or Focused Charge; occupies an augmentation slot in it, lasts 1 encounter once activated.

expert.summary: Add an Augmentation Slot to the Spirit-Forged Relic until repop, up to 1 extra per technique in Relic Affinity; or power an augment in it without expending it.

master.summary: Spirit-Forged Relic deals Radiance, Nature, Dream, Spirit, or Magic for 1 encounter.

grandmaster.summary: Until next repop, each Basic use may also add a damage type (base 6 or the Master list) to that relic. Passive: the Spirit-Forged Relic drops "Physical" from its damage call.

name: The Songweaver
summary: Performer whose magical weaves add slots and protection to items.

innate.name: Weave of Bonding
innate.summary: 30 count with an item: it gains 1 Resist Shatter until used or the event ends.

skills.name: Weave of Augmentation
skills.requirement: Bardic performance. Call: "<Performance> By my (song/voice/dance), I improve this weave - Magic Charm, Grant Augmentation Slot."

basic.summary: Weave on the target's clothing gives one worn item an extra Augmentation Slot. 1 target per use; 1 woven item per person.

expert.summary: New slot also gets an unstable Basic Mystic Weaving Augment. Passive: Basic use may be a group effect. Passive: 1 use and a 10 count restores that unstable augment.

master.summary: New slot gets an unstable Mystic Weaving Augment of Expert or lower. Passive: Basic use is Voice Radius. Passive: Expert use is a group effect.

grandmaster.summary: New slot gets an unstable Mystic Weaving Augment of Master or lower. Passive: Expert use is Voice Radius. Passive: Master use is a group effect.

skills.name: Weave of Enchantment
skills.requirement: A person may carry only 1 Weave of Enchantment, Elements, Strengthening, or Inspiration.

basic.summary: 10 count, weave into a worn item's augmentation slot: 1 Resist Disenchant, counts as an Unstable Augment; if the wearer dies, they keep enhancements normally lost on death.

expert.summary: 10 count: Weave of Elements in a weapon's augmentation slot; on activation the wielder picks a base element and swings it for the encounter or until disenchanted.

master.summary: 10 count: Weave of Strengthening in an item's augmentation slot; unshatterable (call "No effect") until disenchanted or next repop.

grandmaster.summary: 10 count: Weave of Inspiration in an item's augmentation slot, costs 1 use less for an encounter: weapon offensive, shield or armor defensive, jewelry utility, clothing in a base magic's color that magic.

name: The Sorcerer
summary: Caster who keeps a fixed list of known spells in the body instead of a spellbook.

innate.name: Always Prepared
innate.summary: Per magic type known, pick 2 known spells per spell level; only known spells can be cast. Swap one by absorbing a spell copy of the new spell on a 100 count (copy destroyed), dropping one of the same element and level. Each new basic magic technique or new basic magic type adds 2 rulebook spells. Keep the list on the sheet.

detriment.summary: Cannot cast spells from a spellbook.

skills.name: Spell Preparation
skills.requirement: Known spell list. Prepared spells in an (E) slot end at the end of the encounter they were cast in.

basic.summary: Prepare a basic known spell for the repop; cast it unmodified once per encounter with no skill uses.

expert.summary: Same for an expert known spell.

master.summary: Same for a master known spell. Passive: prepared spells may be modified with other known magic skills, paying those uses.

grandmaster.summary: Same for a grandmaster known spell (text omits "unmodified").

basic.summary: Cast a Basic spell from your known list.

expert.summary: Cast an Expert spell from your known list.

master.summary: Cast a Master spell from your known list.

grandmaster.summary: Cast a Grandmaster spell from your known list.

name: The Spirit Speaker
summary: Specialist in living and dead spirits who crafts spirit tokens.

innate.name: Spirit Sight
innate.summary: Has spirit sight; grant it to someone for an encounter on a 100 count. Counts as a set of Spirit token crafting tools.

basic.summary: 5 count, then for the encounter talk with any creature with a living spirit: "Spirit of Communication." (E)

expert.summary: "Spirit of Protection, <Option>": give self or another a Resist Pain, Evade, or Boon Element. (E)

master.summary: 100 count with ancestor spirits: they take an enhancement slot and give Expert level plus the Expert technique of any basic rulebook skill; not the same skill twice per repop.

grandmaster.summary: 100 count, "Spirit of Life": takes a general enhancement slot, immunity to instant death. On bleed out or death, spend it within 5 minutes for "Spirit of Rebirth", a self Raise Dead to full life points. (E)

skills.name: Spirit Token
skills.requirement: Crafting: 5 minutes, stable or unstable, not enhanceable by other crafting skills. Each token type: 1 active per person, none of that type again in the same encounter once spent.

basic.summary: Craft a Status Token (attuned to Corruption, Destruction, Disease, Fear, Poison, Silence, Sleep, Slow, Stun, or Weakness): remove that status on a 30 count, or spend it to resist it. (E)

expert.summary: Craft a Damage Token (Fire, Lightning, Ice, Earth, Essence, Harm, Magic, Nature, Dream, or Spirit): weapon, claw, and relic attacks deal that type; spend for one 100 damage effect of it. (E)

master.summary: Craft a Reduction Token (Claw, Edge, Blunt, Fire, Air/Lightning, Water/Ice, Earth/Stone, Essence, Harm, Magic, Nature, Nightmare, Dream, Acid, Chaos, Order, or Spirit): reduce all damage of that type; spend for one resist damage of it. (E)

grandmaster.summary: Craft an Absorption Token: one Resist Effect that also restores 1 basic skill use of the holder's choice. (E)

name: The Umbral Guide
summary: Infiltrator and poisoner who leads small groups through the shadows.

innate.name: Adept Poisoner
innate.summary: Packet-delivered damaging acid attacks from a valid hiding spot during an active Hide are doubled.

basic.summary: Bring 1 + techniques known people (max 4 plus self) into a Hide; they can follow a Hop and must stay within arm's reach or are revealed.

expert.summary: Distract an NPC not in combat: "Lash Ignore - 60 seconds"; ends early for all if any affected target is attacked; Hide continues.

master.summary: "Fade": up to 10 seconds or 10 steps to reach a valid Hide spot. Reach it and effects taken during the Fade are negated and you are hidden even if watched; fail and all effects land and you are revealed. Passive: group Hop lasts 15 seconds/steps.

grandmaster.summary: "Umbral Shift" between valid hiding spots in line of sight at least at a fast walk, with up to 4 others; hands or weapons crossed over the head.

basic.summary: Press one non-damaging packet venom (once per venom, one target), or resist any call containing Venom or Poison.

expert.summary: Fork a non-damaging packet venom: 1 extra packet within 5 seconds at a different target; forked venom cannot be pressed. Passive: immune to your own Poison, Venom, or Acid.

master.summary: Reclaim a thrown venom whose packet missed every target out of game (keep the tag), or Press any venom (damaging or not, packet or weapon).

grandmaster.summary: Fork damaging packet venoms too (other Expert conditions apply), or deliver a damaging venom or acid as a Lash.

name: The Warblade
summary: Warrior with a supernatural bond to a single weapon.

innate.name: Bond Weapon
innate.summary: Bonding takes one full event using only that weapon; it then holds one of your spirit fragments, lost only if forsaken or destroyed. +1 passive damage while wielding it. Only 1 bonded weapon. Immune to effects from your bonded weapon (such as Riposte).

detriment.summary: From the Calling description (no labeled detriment): Warblade powers do not work with any other weapon, and the bonded weapon can be used against you.

basic.summary: Spend uses of this skill in place of uses of offensive weapon skills you know (for example Aggression, Backstrike, Speed of Blade).

expert.summary: When attacking with the bonded weapon through an ability, use that ability 1 extra time; once per attack.

master.summary: "Flurry, 100 X, 100 X, 100 X" with the bonded weapon, X being your damage type.

grandmaster.summary: Three consecutive "Crush Slay" attacks with the bonded weapon.

basic.summary: Bonded weapon deals Magic damage for an encounter.

expert.summary: Weapon Strike or Spell Strike with the bonded weapon.

master.summary: One frontal cone weapon attack with the bonded weapon.

grandmaster.summary: One lash weapon attack with the bonded weapon.
